summary: Frontend-only regression for Poly World City Screen drag-and-drop building placement (Phase 2). Full flow verified end-to-end at 390x844: Main Menu -> New Game -> Single Player -> Start -> Skip tutorial -> tap capital (195,420) -> Enter the City -> city-screen. Buildings sheet lists all four buildings with correct sizes/costs (House 2x2 · 2 planks, Material Factory 3x3, Trade Tower 4x4 · 100 stars, Park 2x2 · 15 stars + 5 glass). Selecting a building shows the placement hint 'Drag to position · release to place' and mounts the full-screen place-layer (testID place-layer). Drag/ghost interaction WORKS: a red SVG diamond (rgba(220,70,70,0.55)) appears as ghost while dragging; releasing on an invalid cell dismisses placement and fires the 'Placement cancelled' toast (i.e. the commitGhost onCancelPlace path). Citadel-blocked validation CONFIRMED: dragging Trade Tower over the central 6x6 citadel footprint yields a red ghost (fill=rgba(220,70,70,0.55) via document.querySelectorAll('svg polygon')). Affordability validation CONFIRMED indirectly: with a fresh capital player has 0 planks / 0 glass / 6 stars, so House (2 planks), Trade Tower (100 stars) and Park (15 stars + 5 glass) all remain red anywhere on the grid — this matches the reviewer's note that green placement cannot be observed without cheating resources. No green ghost / no successful placement was observed because starting resources are insufficient for every buildable option; this is EXPECTED per the request. Citadel button opens citadel-dialog correctly; Exit (city-exit) returns to the game map and unmounts city-screen. Only benign RN Web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' style props, props.pointerEvents, Image style.resizeMode) — non-blocking, already tracked in previous iterations.

issues: Material Factory row shows no visible cost badge because its cost object appears to have no goods entries in CITY_BUILDINGS[factory]; player can still 'select' it as a placeable target. Please verify factory.cost / factory.stars are intended to be zero or add cost chips so users see what it requires (consistent with the other three buildings).

action_items: (Non-blocking) Verify Material Factory (CITY_BUILDINGS[factory]) has an intended cost/stars value — currently the Buildings sheet renders no cost chip for it, which may confuse users.
(Non-blocking) Silence RN Web deprecations: migrate shadow() helper to boxShadow, move pointerEvents from prop to style, use props.resizeMode on all <Image>.

(Enhancement) Consider a keyboard/dev-only 'cheat resources' path (or a demo save slot) so QA can visually verify a GREEN ghost + successful placement + cost deduction; today with a brand-new capital every building is unaffordable so the successful-placement branch (onPlace -> 'X built' toast + building sprite on grid + resource deduction) cannot be exercised from the default flow.
(No fix required) Drag-and-drop placement + validation (off-map / citadel / overlap / affordability) all functioning per canPlaceCityBuilding in /app/frontend/src/game/engine.ts:164-189.
critical_code_review_comments: CityMap.tsx placeGesture uses Gesture.Pan(); on web a very small mouse movement (<Pan activation threshold, ~10px) will not activate the pan and no ghost is drawn — user must move noticeably before release. Consider Gesture.Pan().minDistance(0) or a tap-then-drag fallback so a quick click also triggers placement resolution.

commitGhost() calls onCancelPlace when ghost.ok is false, and the parent shows a 'Placement cancelled' toast — but a red ghost drop is often caused by 'Not enough X' rather than a deliberate cancel. Consider forwarding the reason string from canPlaceCityBuilding (already returned) into a more actionable toast like 'Not enough planks' / 'Blocked by citadel' instead of the generic 'Placement cancelled'.

The place-layer covers the whole screen while placing (StyleSheet.absoluteFill), meaning pan/pinch of the map is disabled during placement. Acceptable, but there's no obvious way to cancel placement other than dropping on an invalid cell — consider adding a visible Cancel button or a tap-outside-to-cancel affordance.
seed_data_creation: None — fresh single-player game created via New Game flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reach City Screen at 390x844: menu-new-game -> mode-single -> start-game -> (skip tutorial by tapping Skip text if present) -> mouse.click(195,420) -> click enter-city -> wait for city-screen. Once in city-screen, select a building via city-buildings -> build-{id}; place-layer mounts. Ghost polygon fills are literal rgba strings 'rgba(80,200,110,0.55)' (green/valid) or 'rgba(220,70,70,0.55)' (red/invalid) and can be read via document.querySelectorAll('svg polygon') + getAttribute('fill'). Fresh capital has 0 planks/stone/sand/glass/coal and 6 stars, so no default building is affordable — the ghost stays red everywhere. To observe a GREEN ghost + successful onPlace, the tester needs to seed extra resources on the player (or the main agent needs to grant a dev cheat). Gesture.Pan requires >~10px movement to activate on web; use mouse.move steps >=5 with cumulative delta >20px to reliably trigger the ghost.
